flows.title: First visit → download
flows.summary: A maker lands on equipe.im, reads the hero, scrolls to Get started and downloads the Mac app (DMG). The download itself has no on-page state: the browser takes over.

screens.title: Home · first screen
screens.note: Primary action: Download for Mac (DMG); the CLI link is secondary. Offline isn't a state of its own: the site is static, with no service worker, so offline is the browser's own page.

flows.title: Get the phone app
flows.summary: equipe.im/app: the one address for the QR code, the App Store listing and the APK. A Mac sees every platform; an iPhone or Android phone sees its own app first. Layout is picked from the browser, with no redirect. (The walkthrough shows the Mac layout; the phone layouts are in the screens above.)
